_README: Own first-principles EoS for the FeSiOCS core solid endmembers, from our QHA campaign (qha_campaign/). V0/K0/K0' are pinned by static E(V) over V/V0 = 0.55-1.02 (phonon volumes plus low-compression anchors). gamma0/q are the direct thermodynamic Grueneisen (gamma = V (dS/dV)/C_V from F(V,T)): own where the phonon data is clean (hcp/FeSi/Fe7C3, plus Fe3S; each agrees with the literature gamma), literature fallback where F_vib is too noisy (B1_FeO) -- see thermal_source per phase. density_gate_max_pct_vs_lit is the fit-free -dF/dV density check vs the imported EoS across the core range. hcp-Fe K0 differs from Dewaele by design (nonmagnetic PBE vs an experimental fit through the magnetic collapse); the two agree in the core. Reproduce: python fit_eos_qha.py.
reference_isotherm: 0 K static (cold); thermal added via Debye-Grueneisen
